title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(円井基史研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III(Marui Motofumi)
keywords: Architectural environmental engineering 2.Urban thermal environment 3.Utilization of green 4.Environmental design
educationalGoal: Students will learn about comfortable living with less environmental impact and urban development with natural environmental symbiosis. They will discover specific problems related to architectural environments and propose solutions. They will learn the design process of assigning settings, selecting methods, investigating/experimenting/ analyzing/verifying and proposing solutions. They will cultivate the ability to summarize results and make presentations.
advice: [First term] ・Themes are decided through bibliographic surveys, field surveys, and preliminary experiments. ・Challenges are set and methods are selected. ・Students make interim presentations [Second term] ・Students pursue initiatives to resolve issues, analyze data, and propose solutions. ・Students create their reports. ・Students present their findings.
requiredKnowledge: ・Basic subjects of architecture. ・Broad interest in physics, biology, chemistry, materials, weather, history, the global environment, etc. ・Awareness of environmental issues and actions.

activityGoals.body: Students can set specific project issues through bibliographic surveys, field surveys, and experiments.
Students can make plans for solving the problems.
Students can investigate, experiment, analyze, verify, and propose solutions
Students can summarize their results in a report and give a presentation.
